```{ojs}
// A one-time native listener, not a cell reactive on exampleSelect: a
// <select> fires both "input" and "change", and two overlapping applies race.
applyExampleFromSelect = {
  const nativeSelect = (viewof exampleSelect).querySelector("select")
  if (!nativeSelect) return
  nativeSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const example = (viewof exampleSelect).value
    if (!example) return
    VM.ui.applyExampleParams(exampleFieldSelectors, example.params, viewof plotTrigger)
  })
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// The text fields take effect on Resample (read through their stable
// views, so typing doesn't rerun this); the two selects are always-live.
committed = {
  plotTrigger
  const aRaw = (viewof aText).value, bRaw = (viewof bText).value
  const nRaw = (viewof resamplesInput).value, seedRaw = (viewof seedInput).value
  const parsedN = VM.expressions.makeNumber(window.math, nRaw)
  const N = Number.isFinite(parsedN) ? Math.min(100000, Math.max(10, Math.round(parsedN))) : 10000
  const parsedSeed = VM.expressions.makeNumber(window.math, seedRaw)
  const seed = Number.isFinite(parsedSeed) ? Math.round(parsedSeed) : 1
  VM.ui.syncUrlParams({
    a: [aRaw, defaults.a], b: [bRaw, defaults.b],
    stat: [statSelect, defaults.stat], method: [methodSelect, defaults.method],
    resamples: [nRaw, defaults.resamples], seed: [seedRaw, defaults.seed]
  })
  return {A: parseData(aRaw), B: parseData(bRaw), stat: statSelect, method: methodSelect, N, seed}
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// result: all N resamples, their statistics, and the fixed ranges every
// chart below uses, so moving the k slider never rescales an axis.
result = {
  const {A, B, stat, method, N, seed} = committed
  if (!A || !B) return {ok: false, N}
  const run = resample(A, B, {stat, method, N, rng: VM.sampling.seededRandom(seed)})
  const pooled = [...A, ...B]
  const shift = [0, 0]
  if (method === "recentered") {
    shift[0] = statistics[stat](A)
    shift[1] = statistics[stat](B)
  }
  // What the top panel draws: each pooled value, re-centered by its own
  // group's statistic in the re-centered test.
  const shown = pooled.map((v, i) => v - shift[i < A.length ? 0 : 1])

  let lo = Infinity, hi = -Infinity
  for (const d of run.deltas) { if (d < lo) lo = d; if (d > hi) hi = d }
  lo = Math.min(lo, run.obs, 0); hi = Math.max(hi, run.obs, 0)
  const binCount = 60
  const binWidth = (hi - lo) / binCount || 1
  const finalCounts = new Array(binCount).fill(0)
  for (const d of run.deltas) finalCounts[Math.min(binCount - 1, Math.floor((d - lo) / binWidth))]++

  const xPad = (Math.max(...shown) - Math.min(...shown)) * 0.04 || 1
  return {
    ok: true, ...run, A, B, pooled, shown, shift, stat, method, N,
    bins: {lo, binWidth, binCount, yMax: Math.max(...finalCounts) * 1.08},
    dotRange: [Math.min(...shown) - xPad, Math.max(...shown) + xPad],
    histRange: [lo - binWidth, hi + binWidth]
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// setup: the first k resamples. k = 0 shows the data themselves.
setup = {
  if (!result.ok) return {ok: false}
  const k = Math.min(Number(stepControl), result.N)
  const {nA, nB, obs, deltas, picks, bins, method} = result
  const n = nA + nB

  // Top panel: which value sits in which row, and its original group.
  const dots = []
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const p = k === 0 ? i : picks[(k - 1) * n + i]
    dots.push({value: result.shown[p], row: i < nA ? 1 : 0, from: p < nA ? "A" : "B"})
  }
  const rowStats = [0, 1].map(row => statistics[result.stat](dots.filter(d => d.row === row).map(d => d.value)))

  const counts = new Array(bins.binCount).fill(0)
  for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) counts[Math.min(bins.binCount - 1, Math.floor((deltas[i] - bins.lo) / bins.binWidth))]++

  const summary = {k, obs, current: k > 0 ? deltas[k - 1] : null}
  if (method === "interval") {
    summary.interval = k >= 2 ? percentileInterval(deltas, k) : null
  } else {
    summary.p = k > 0 ? pValue(deltas, obs, k) : null
    let count = 0
    for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) if (deltas[i] >= obs - 1e-9) count++
    summary.count = count
  }
  return {ok: true, dots, rowStats, counts, ...summary}
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mainPlot = {
  const Plotly = window.Plotly
  let _plotDiv = null

  return (setup) => {
    const data = [], shapes = [], annotations = []
    const layout = {
      grid: {rows: 2, columns: 1, pattern: "independent", roworder: "top to bottom"},
      margin: {l: 64, r: 16, t: 16, b: 48},
      xaxis: {domain: [0, 1], anchor: "y", title: {text: result.method === "recentered" ? "value − own group's " + statLabels.get(result.stat ?? "median").toLowerCase() : "value", standoff: 4}},
      yaxis: {domain: [0.56, 1], anchor: "x", range: [-0.35, 1.85], tickvals: [0, 1], ticktext: ["B", "A"], zeroline: false, showgrid: false, fixedrange: true},
      xaxis2: {domain: [0, 1], anchor: "y2", title: {text: "Δ* = statistic(B*) − statistic(A*)", standoff: 4}},
      yaxis2: {domain: [0, 0.38], anchor: "x2", title: {text: "count", standoff: 8}, rangemode: "tozero", nticks: 4},
      hovermode: "closest", uirevision: "static", autosize: true, bargap: 0.05,
      shapes, annotations
    }

    if (!setup.ok) {
      layout.annotations = VM.plotting.emptyState("Couldn't read the data: give each group two or more numbers.")
    } else {
      const label = setup.k === 0 ? ["B", "A"] : ["B*", "A*"]
      layout.yaxis.ticktext = label
      layout.xaxis.range = result.dotRange
      layout.xaxis2.range = result.histRange
      layout.yaxis2.range = [0, result.bins.yMax]

      // Dots stack upward within their row, one step per repeat of a
      // value -- which is also how a bootstrap draw's duplicates show.
      const binWidth = (result.dotRange[1] - result.dotRange[0]) / 60
      const groups = {A: [], B: []}
      for (const row of [1, 0]) {
        const inRow = setup.dots.filter(d => d.row === row)
        const levels = stackLevels(inRow.map(d => d.value), binWidth)
        const step = Math.min(0.12, 0.75 / (Math.max(...levels) + 1))
        inRow.forEach((d, i) => groups[d.from].push({x: d.value, y: row + 0.06 + levels[i] * step}))
      }
      for (const [from, color] of [["A", chartColors.fn], ["B", chartColors.alt]]) {
        data.push({
          x: groups[from].map(d => d.x), y: groups[from].map(d => d.y), xaxis: "x", yaxis: "y",
          type: "scatter", mode: "markers", name: `from group ${from}`, showlegend: false,
          marker: {color, size: 7, line: {color: chartColors.halo, width: 0.5}},
          hovertemplate: `from group ${from}<br>%{x:.4g}<extra></extra>`
        })
      }
      // Each row's statistic, as a short tick across the row.
      for (const row of [0, 1]) {
        shapes.push({type: "line", xref: "x", yref: "y", x0: setup.rowStats[row], x1: setup.rowStats[row], y0: row - 0.2, y1: row + 0.85, line: {color: chartColors.ink, width: 2}})
      }

      // Histogram of the first k Δ*, the tail (or the interval) in its own color.
      const {lo, binWidth: w, binCount} = result.bins
      const centers = Array.from({length: binCount}, (_, i) => lo + (i + 0.5) * w)
      const colors = centers.map(c => {
        if (result.method === "interval") {
          return setup.interval && c >= setup.interval[0] && c <= setup.interval[1] ? chartColors.ok : VM.plotting.alpha("muted", 0.5)
        }
        return c + w / 2 > setup.obs ? chartColors.alt : VM.plotting.alpha("fn", 0.55)
      })
      data.push({
        x: centers, y: setup.counts, width: w, type: "bar", xaxis: "x2", yaxis: "y2", name: "Δ*", showlegend: false,
        marker: {color: colors}, hovertemplate: "Δ* ≈ %{x:.3g}<br>count %{y}<extra></extra>"
      })
      shapes.push({type: "line", xref: "x2", yref: "y2", x0: setup.obs, x1: setup.obs, y0: 0, y1: result.bins.yMax, line: {color: chartColors.ink, width: 2, dash: "dash"}})
      annotations.push({xref: "x2", yref: "y2", x: setup.obs, y: result.bins.yMax, text: `Δ<sub>obs</sub> = ${setup.obs.toFixed(2)}`, showarrow: false, yanchor: "top", xanchor: "right", xshift: -4, font: {color: chartColors.ink}})
      if (setup.current !== null) {
        data.push({
          x: [setup.current], y: [0], xaxis: "x2", yaxis: "y2", type: "scatter", mode: "markers", name: "this Δ*", showlegend: false,
          marker: {color: chartColors.warn, size: 11, symbol: "triangle-up", line: {color: chartColors.halo, width: 1}},
          hovertemplate: "this resample's Δ* = %{x:.4g}<extra></extra>", cliponaxis: false
        })
      }
    }

    const config = VM.plotting.config()
    if (!_plotDiv) {
      _plotDiv = document.createElement("div")
      _plotDiv.className = "plotly-box-large"
      Plotly.newPlot(_plotDiv, data, layout, config)
      VM.plotting.autoResize(_plotDiv)
    } else {
      Plotly.react(_plotDiv, data, layout, config)
    }
    return _plotDiv
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
stats = {
  if (!setup.ok) return VM.ui.statRow([{label: "Δ obs", value: "—"}])
  const fmt = v => v === null ? "—" : Math.abs(v) < 1e-3 && v !== 0 ? v.toExponential(1) : v.toFixed(4)
  const items = [{label: "Δ obs", value: setup.obs.toFixed(2)}, {label: "Resamples k", value: setup.k.toLocaleString()}]
  if (result.method === "interval") {
    const iv = setup.interval
    items.push({label: "95% interval", value: iv ? `[${iv[0].toFixed(2)}, ${iv[1].toFixed(2)}]` : "—"})
  } else {
    items.push({label: "Δ* ≥ Δ obs", value: setup.count.toLocaleString()})
    const report = setup.k > 0 && setup.count === 0 ? `< ${fmt(1 / (setup.k + 1))}` : fmt(setup.p)
    items.push({label: "p̂ = (1 + count)/(k + 1)", value: report})
  }
  return VM.ui.statRow(items)
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof stepControl = {
  const start = initialK === null ? result.N : Math.min(result.N, Math.max(0, Math.round(initialK)))
  const slider = Inputs.range([0, result.N], {step: 1, value: start, label: "k"})
  slider.classList.add("ojs-fill")
  return slider
}
```
